national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Economic Resilience at 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman spoke at the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave in New Delhi, emphasizing fiscal prudence, infrastructure investment, and banking reforms.
She noted that IMF projects India's general government debt to decline from 83.4 percent of GDP in 2026 to 77.7 percent in 2031 against global trends.
Capital expenditure for the fiscal was budgeted at 12.22 lakh crore rupees, with significant expansions in national highways and operational airports since 2014.

national_news.title: India Secures Multiple Medals at Asian Games, Climbs to Fourth Place
bullets: India won five gold, two silver, and two bronze medals at the Asian Games, bringing the total medal tally to 85 (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze) and placing fourth overall.
The Indian men's hockey team won gold by defeating Malaysia 5-1, securing direct qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
Pranavi Urs made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win an Asian Games gold medal in the individual golf event.

bihar_news.title: Changing Geography and Impact Patterns of Bihar Floods
bullets: Data from Bihar's Disaster Management Department highlights changing flood dynamics: 50.49 lakh people across 15 districts were affected in Sept 2026, compared to 48 lakh across 23 districts in 2025 and 52.46 lakh across 28 districts in 2024.
Shifting river courses, embankment breaches, and flooding along rivers like the Gandak are expanding vulnerabilities into new settlements and non-traditional risk areas.
The analysis emphasizes a transition from routine emergency response to a sustained risk reduction framework through updated vulnerability mapping and resilient infrastructure design.
